name: Globalization
excerpt: Globalization is the trend toward a more interdependent world economy.
notes: Globalization refers to the trend of the world economy becoming a more interdependent system, characterized by the collapse of time and distance and the decline in barriers to trade.
context_summary:
- Globalization is a trend toward a more interdependent world economy.
- It is characterized by the collapse of time and distance.
- There is a decline in barriers to trade.
